divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

input: the 39 hand-built records of GRCh38-release116 followed by two records Ensembl VEP skips before annotation: one on a chromosome absent from the cache (Parser.pm validate_vf, the offline branch) and one whose alleles X/Y carry no ACGTN run (the allele-string check); both get no row in any format
generator: copied from tests/golden/116/GRCh38-release116 with the two records appended; scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py classify over the default output of the tree this corpus is committed with, which writes no row for either appended record
expected_outputs: the GRCh38-release116 reference outputs: the same 39 annotated records against the same cache under the same flags, and the two appended records are skipped before annotation, so the four files are identical; default.txt_warnings.txt and skipped.txt carry the five records Ensembl VEP skips (the reference_warning of each record, recorded from its run) rendered as BaseVEP.pm:840-863 renders a warning (the input line collapsed to single spaces and cut to 50 characters) and BaseRunner.pm:364-380 the skipped-variants file (Line %-5s, the line to 40 characters, the reason), the header naming variants.vcf; the plugin_*_warnings.txt files are the same five lines plus the plugin-loading lines their run expects, paths masked as <path>; ensembl_input.txt is default.txt's header and the 124 rows of its 19 records named in variants.ensembl.txt, which Ensembl VEP writes alike for the two shapes of one variant (Parser/VCF.pm derives the start, end and allele string the Ensembl line states, and the identifier column names the variant as the VCF ID does), and ensembl_input_warnings.txt the two skips it reports for that input at their record numbers; input_data.txt is default.txt's header and the 3 rows of the two records the input-data runs pass as a string
plugin_data: LoFtool_scores.slice.txt: the first 20 lines (the header and 19 genes) of LoFtool_scores.txt from the Ensembl VEP_plugins repository at release/116 (Apache License 2.0), line endings normalised; the plugin-loftool-column run expects the LoFtool_percentile column, not its values

input_twins.variants.vcf.gz: variants.vcf as BGZF: one gzip member per block of at most 65280 bytes, each with the BC extra subfield, then the empty end-of-file block; the same 41 records, so the twin's expected outputs are the default run's
input_twins.variants.plain-gzip.vcf.gz: variants.vcf as one plain gzip member (gzip -9 -n), no extra field; the same 41 records, so the twin's expected outputs are the default run's
input_twins.variants.ensembl.txt: the 19 sequence-variant records of variants.vcf in Ensembl's format, tab-delimited (chromosome, start, end, allele string, strand 1, the VCF ID as the identifier; the VCF anchor base dropped, an insertion's start one past its end), followed by the chromosome Z record and the X/Y record; the breakend and symbolic structural records have no Ensembl-format shape and are left out
